name: pointly
description: Pointly — Planning Poker web sem cadastro (monorepo Bun)

scripts.typecheck: bun --filter pointly-web typecheck && bun --filter server typecheck && bun --filter @planning-poker/shared typecheck
scripts.test: bun --filter pointly-web test && bun --filter server test && bun --filter @planning-poker/shared test
scripts.build: bun --filter pointly-web build && bun --filter server build
scripts.verify: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build:web
